body:
In `EmailValidator` the email is considered invalid if it is longer than 320 characters
https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/validators/EmailValidator.php#L74

But I found the answer to the SO which states that the maximum length 254
http://stackoverflow.com/a/574698
It work only on the server side((

I guess 320 chars is:
- 254 chars for the email address
- other 66 chars for the recipient name (see `allowName` option)

It may be fixed to use different allowed length depending on `allowName` property, but it's not a serious problem.

> It work only on the server side((

@vorobyev what do you mean? Do you have problems with JS validation?
SilverFire, JS not check email length. Validation is go, when form is submitted. Other validations are normal work in the client side.

@vorobyev you're right, there is not length check on the client-side. See [yii.validation.js:188](https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/blob/master/framework/assets/yii.validation.js#L188)

@samdark should it be fixed?

JavaScript length check could be added.

Allowed length could be corrected as well but we need to make sure. In that StackOverflow answer there are many good references including reference validator.
SO links to IETF RFCs errata so that is a good source to refer to. Should be checked in very detail though.

issue.title: Fixed EmailValidator to check email length properly
